name: qaren
description: A QA engineer for your coding agent. It tests each React Native change on a simulator and tells you PASS or FAIL, with video proof.

interface.shortDescription: QA a React Native app on a device with evidence
interface.longDescription: A QA engineer for your coding agent. It tests each React Native change on a simulator and tells you PASS or FAIL, with video proof. Run the qaren CLI from Codex on an iOS simulator or Android emulator and read the receipt back; guided setup covers iOS.
defaultPrompt: QA this pull request on the iOS simulator.
Check the working tree with QaReN.
